data.title: Binance Completes 4th Quarter Token Burn
data.body:
Fellow Binancians,

In accordance with our whitepaper, we have completed our 4th quarter token burn of 2,528,767 BNB (roughly $30MM USD equivalent).

Burn Txid: https://etherscan.io/tx/0x7a07faca141707c9d6aa92b1f2e5e8e9420f2b43d36ced1126d061582e3ae9fa

New BNB Total Supply: 192,443,301 BNB

New BNB Circulating Supply: 144,443,301 BNB

Thanks for your support!

Binance Team

2018/07/18

 

Find us on

Telegram: https://t.me/binanceexchange

Twitter: https://twitter.com/binance
